p1c11.caption: Figure XI · The diptych, posted
p1c11.opener_composition: Two red-ink posted bills side by side (LEFT / RIGHT) sharing one gilt frame; a Q-virus wax seal bridges the gutter. Blackletter bill heads are HTML overlays.
p1c11.opener_rationale: The chapter dissolves left-vs-right into organization theory — a diptych that is visibly one sheet makes the argument graphically. Red-ink proclamation craft per lock.
p1c11.palette_role: Signal Red bills on Press Black, gilt shared frame.
p1c11.reading_treatment: Ruled bill-clause paragraphs for the nomos chain; red rubric M/Q margin sigils at first uses; burnt-deed singed edges on the antinomian gallery.
p1c11.title: The Truth About Left and Right

p1c12.caption: Figure XII · Against the dam
p1c12.opener_composition: Proclamation broadside: a ruled dam wall (Boulder Dam analogy, 'La Wik direct action') holding back a red-ink torrent of posted bills. Portrait-leaning composition, wall left, torrent right.
p1c12.opener_rationale: Ch 12's central set-piece is the Boulder Dam / direct-action analogy and the survey of tactics — dam-vs-torrent stages 'what is to be done' as pressure against a wall.
p1c12.palette_role: ink + Signal Red torrent, gilt wall rules.
p1c12.reading_treatment: Rubricated charter-notices for the Salomon and Pobedonostsev quotations; Fragebogen form-notice grid divider before P57.
p1c12.title: What Is to Be Done?

p1c13.caption: Figure XIII · Patent of the pilots
p1c13.opener_composition: Red-ink letters-patent: the pilots' directorate key large at center, Trust seal below, Plaincorp/Trust/Receiver hierarchy as a chancery table. Most formal opener in the book.
p1c13.opener_rationale: The chapter is a constitutional document (Trust, Receiver, PHT franchise) — letters-patent is its native form. Key + Trust knot carry the 'all power to the pilots' close.
p1c13.palette_role: brass + Signal Red seals on Press Black; closing cockade nearby in end-mark family.
p1c13.reading_treatment: Sealed office-notice callouts (Receiver/Director/Trust); tally-board SFGate figures; ruled instrument-notice divider for the antenna passage; white cockade closes beside the trust-knot end-seal.
p1c13.title: Tactics and Structures of Any Prospective Restoration

p1c14.caption: Figure XIV · Commissioned, dismissed, sealed
p1c14.opener_composition: Red-ink commission scroll unfurling over a small ember starfield; the white cockade returns as the closing seal. Mirror of ch 1's tear: the book opens by ripping scenery and closes by signing orders.
p1c14.opener_rationale: The send-off chapter (space-lieutenant framing, 'rules', the Bazaar/Cathedral close) wants ceremony: a commission, not an essay header. The closing cockade rhymes cover + ch 3 + ch 13.
p1c14.palette_role: ember starfield + Signal Red scroll + white cockade on near-black.
p1c14.reading_treatment: Five rule tablets as posted bills I–V wayposted through the read; charter-notices for the horror tour; facing-bill spread for the Gladstone–Tennyson debate; ruled tariff-notice divider for King Ine; tailor's-needle parting device at the close.
p1c14.title: Rules for Reactionaries
